verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing clearly documents a prefunded balance model (fund via bank transfer to a Stripe balance) and a real-time authorization webhook for approving/declining each authorization, which resembles JIT decisioning, but evidence never frames this as an alternate 'just-in-time funding' mode nor discusses cash-flow tradeoffs between the two approaches. Community comment confirms cards draw from a single prefunded Stripe balance, suggesting JIT funding (system funds each authorization individually) isn't a distinct documented option. Missing for 10: explicit JIT funding mechanism separate from balance/webhook approval, and documented cash-flow tradeoff guidance comparing prefunded vs JIT.
